operations.title: Degenerate pairing turns rigidity into a radical obstruction class
operations.statement: For right radical R a subcomplex, pairing-preserving corrections are radical-valued. A chain-map repair exists iff Omega vanishes in C(H)/R and its radical-valued class vanishes in H^(-1)(Hom(C(G),R)). Perfect pairing recovers Omega=0.

operations.title: Two-stage falsifier for pairing-preserving repair
operations.procedure: Project Omega to C(H)/R; if zero, compute its class in H^(-1)(Hom(C(G),R)).
operations.falsifier: A nonzero quotient projection or nonzero radical cohomology class excludes every pairing-preserving correction.
operations.pass_condition: Exhibit radical-valued C with delta C=-Omega.
